title: Consultant communication and delivery — D2
purpose: Working sequence for Consultant communication and delivery: workshops, executive outcomes, engineering detail, options, proposals, assumptions, risks, and review feedback.
routing_rationale: Use the D2 lens to keep workshops, executive outcomes, engineering detail, options, proposals, assumptions, risks, and review feedback connected to an explicit owner, evidence path, and recovery action.
summary: Turn discovery into executive outcomes, engineering constraints, options, a recommendation, and an agreed delivery record.

nodes.label: Discovery Workshop
nodes.detail: The facilitated session that exposes outcomes, constraints, and risks.

nodes.label: Engineering Constraints
nodes.detail: The detail engineers need to validate feasibility.

nodes.label: Options Matrix
nodes.detail: At least two viable options with explicit trade-offs.

nodes.label: Assumptions and Risk Log
nodes.detail: Uncertainty that needs an owner and a next action.

nodes.label: Recommendation and Review
nodes.detail: The selected path and the feedback loop that keeps it honest.

steps.title: Working sequence: Discovery Workshop → Engineering Constraints
steps.action: Discovery Workshop capture constraints to Engineering Constraints; record evidence for workshops, executive outcomes, engineering detail, options, proposals, assumptions, risks, and review feedback.
steps.why_traversal: Follow the handoff sequence for Consultant communication and delivery by making Engineering Constraints an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e2 for Consultant communication and delivery

steps.title: Working sequence: Executive Outcome → Options Matrix
steps.action: Executive Outcome compare value to Options Matrix; record evidence for workshops, executive outcomes, engineering detail, options, proposals, assumptions, risks, and review feedback.
steps.why_traversal: Follow the handoff sequence for Consultant communication and delivery by making Options Matrix an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e3 for Consultant communication and delivery

scenarios.label: The recommendation has no alternative
scenarios.root_cause: The client cannot see what was rejected or what the trade-off buys.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Consultant communication and delivery path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Options Matrix and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Present multiple options with weighted criteria and consequences.

check.command: review d2 evidence for Options Matrix

scenarios.label: The delivery boundary is ambiguous
scenarios.root_cause: Assumptions become commitments and change requests arrive late.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Consultant communication and delivery path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Proposal / SOW and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Make scope, exclusions, deliverables, and verification dates explicit.

check.command: review d2 evidence for Proposal / SOW

scenarios.label: A risk is recorded without an owner
scenarios.root_cause: An open question persists through approval and delivery.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Consultant communication and delivery path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Assumptions and Risk Log and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Assign an owner, mitigation, evidence, and escalation path.

check.command: review d2 evidence for Assumptions and Risk Log
